rows.ja: ホスティングの供給元

relations.text: Amazonとの商業契約が更新されない場合、別のホスティング先でConnected Operations Platformを設定し直す必要があると説明している
relations.text_en: Says that if Amazon did not allow renewal of its commercial agreement, it would have to set up its Connected Operations Platform on an alternative hosting service

source.label: Samsara 10-K
source.quote: If Amazon decided to compete with us and did not allow us to renew our commercial agreement, this may have a significant impact on our solution and would require that we allocate time and expense to setting up our Connected Operations Platform on an alternative hosting service.
source.note: リスク説明の中での記載です。

relations.text: サムサラの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in Samsara’s annual report

source.label: Samsara 10-K
source.quote: Our primary competitors include vendors like Avigilon, CalAmp, Fleet Complete, Geotab, Lytx, Masternaut, Michelin, Motive, Nauto, Netradyne, Omnitracs, Orbcomm, Platform Science, Skybitz, Spireon, TrackUnit, Verizon Connect, Webfleet, and Zonar.
source.note: Verizon Connectという事業の記載です。
source.note_en: Refers to the Verizon Connect business.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
